findings.current: Still, Go Se-won kept his response to himself and quietly bowed his head.
findings.defect: The draft says he withheld his response, contradicting the apology he immediately gives. The source means he kept his words to a minimum.
findings.rationale: 말을 아꼈다 describes speaking sparingly, not remaining completely silent.
findings.replacement: Still, Go Se-won kept his words to a minimum and quietly bowed his head.
findings.source: 하지만 고세원은 묵묵히 고개를 숙이는 것으로 말을 아꼈다.

findings.current: Lee Jungryong, on the other hand, had remained on the ground and enjoyed a position higher than that of a president or even a king.
findings.defect: The draft makes his status categorically higher, while the source allows it to be equal to or higher than that of a president or king.
findings.rationale: 이상의 means “equal to or greater than,” so the current wording overstates the comparison.
findings.replacement: Lee Jungryong, on the other hand, had remained on the ground and enjoyed a status on par with—or even above—that of a president or king.
findings.source: 이정룡은 지상에 남아 대통령 혹은 왕 이상의 지위를 누렸다.

findings.current: “How many of the people in there haven’t taken our money? Hmm?”
findings.defect: The draft sanitizes both 놈 and the vulgar 받아 처먹은, weakening Go Jun’s contempt and the conspicuous loss of control in his voice.
findings.rationale: The source uses repeated derogatory 놈 and the vulgar 처먹다; strong profanity and contempt are required here.
findings.replacement: “How many of those bastards in there haven’t taken the fucking money we gave them, huh?”
findings.source: “저 안에 있는 놈 중에, 우리가 준 돈 안 받아 처먹은 놈이 얼마나 될까. 응?”

findings.current: > “You were talking about Hunter Jin Taekyung at the end.”
findings.defect: The subject is reversed. The President is explaining that his own final remarks were about Jin Taekyung, not claiming that Jin was talking about himself.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject is the President, established by his preceding speech and his response to Taekyung’s mistaken praise.
findings.replacement: > “Um, that last part was about you, Hunter Jin Taekyung.”

findings.current: > “Ah, wait a moment. My stomach really is churning. I think I’m suddenly getting carsick.”
findings.defect: The draft specifies carsickness even though no car is involved; the source only says motion sickness or nausea.
findings.rationale: 멀미 is general motion sickness; “carsick” adds an absent mode of travel and makes the joke less coherent in the press-conference setting.
findings.replacement: > “Ah, wait a moment. My stomach really is churning. I think I’m suddenly getting motion sickness.”
findings.source: 「아, 잠시만요. 진짜 속 울렁거려요. 갑자기 멀미 날 것 같아요.」

findings.current: > “Fortunately, we were able to bring this incident to an end without any fatalities, but our government intends to take the initiative and begin a thorough investigation. As the President of Korea, I deeply regret this Guild’s negligent response. But as one citizen of this nation as well, I can say that the wishes and legacy of the deceased, who was a great hero, have been passed on in their entirety to Hunter Jin Taekyung—”
findings.defect: The draft incorrectly attaches “as one citizen” to the claim about Lee Jungryong’s legacy. In the source, both the President’s official capacity and his status as a citizen qualify his regret over the Guild’s negligence.
findings.rationale: 대한민국의 대통령으로서 and 한 사람의 국민으로서 are parallel qualifications of 매우 유감스럽다; the current syntax changes the President’s argument.
findings.replacement: > “Fortunately, we were able to bring this incident to an end without any fatalities, but our government intends to take the initiative and begin a thorough investigation. As President of Korea—and as a citizen—I find this Guild’s negligent response deeply regrettable. However, the wishes and legacy of the deceased, who was a great hero, have been passed on in their entirety to Hunter Jin Taekyung—”
findings.source: 「다행히 사망자 없이 사태를 마무리 지었지만, 이번 일은 우리 정부가 나서서 적극적으로 조사를 시작할 방침입니다. 해당 길드의 소홀한 조치는 이 대한민국의 대통령으로서! 더불어 한 사람의 국민으로서 매우 유감스럽지만, 훌륭한 영웅이셨던 고인의 뜻과 유지는 진태경 헌터에게 고스란히 이어져…….」

findings.current: Go Jun was the practical successor who had followed Lee Jungryong.
findings.defect: “Practical successor” is an unnatural calque, and “had followed” ambiguously suggests that Go Jun merely accompanied or obeyed Lee rather than succeeding him.
findings.rationale: 뒤를 이은 실질적인 후계자 directly identifies Go Jun as Lee Jungryong’s de facto successor.
findings.replacement: Go Jun was Lee Jungryong’s de facto successor.
findings.source: 석고준은 이정룡의 뒤를 이은 실질적인 후계자지만,

findings.current: His eyes sank deep into thought.
findings.defect: The draft adds that Go Se-won is lost in thought. The source describes his gaze becoming dark, deep, or inscrutable as he watches Go Jun.
findings.rationale: 눈동자가 깊게 가라앉았다 conveys a darkening, deepening expression rather than the explicit mental activity introduced by “into thought.”
findings.replacement: His gaze grew dark and unfathomable.
findings.source: 이성을 상실한 채 피를 토하듯 고함을 내지르는 석고준의 모습을 응시하는 고세원의 눈동자가 깊게 가라앉았다.

summary: One critical subject reversal, two meaningful register and syntax defects, and four localized fidelity or prose issues.
